linux-resource.scope: Compare a real blocking pipe read and child reaping with reversed order, then attribute CPU clocks to the parent and child separately.
linux-resource.observation: Both runs returned 42 and exit 0. Reversing order moved the waiting period from the read to child reaping, while parent CPU stayed low. Frozen evidence is macOS arm64.

training-performance.scope: Execute the same single-threaded CPU token-classifier update over padded and compact inputs and keep the measurement denominator fixed.
training-performance.observation: Both paths used 352 targets and matched full gradients and weights. Dividing the same loss sum by 1024 reduced the gradient by 352/1024. Two CPU traces and paired windows exclude profiling from the performance comparison.
